items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 29 May 2026 4:50am
items.description:
##Today##

Dry & bright today with spells of sunshine, hazy at times.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 19°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

SW 10-15 soon increasing 15-20, decreasing 10-15 late afternoon & this evening, then backing S or S-SW overnight.


##Visibility##

Good. Patchy hill fog at first and later.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Tomorrow##

Dry morning with bright intervals, but turning cloudier with outbreaks of rain & drizzle developing during afternoon with lowering hill fog & some coastal mist especially around the south & east later. Clearing overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-3


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S or S-SW 10-15, increasing 15-20, then 20-25 in the evening for a time, veering W or SW 15-20 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasional moderate or poor in rain & drizzle or in coastal mist later. Hill fog developing & lowering.


##Comments##

The start of a more unsettled spell.


##Sunday, 31 May 2026##
